business_problem: Exostar needed stronger governance for the large volumes of third-party identities and entitlements moving through its Access: One platform so regulated customers could reduce risk and compliance effort without slowing partner collaboration.
solution_summary: Exostar integrated IBM Verify Identity Governance into its Access: One identity and access management platform to automate governance for partner, supplier and third-party access. Access: One already handled collaboration across complex supply and value chains, but Exostar needed a full-featured governance layer that could correlate disparate identity rights, translate technical permissions into business-friendly policies and support delegated administration at scale. IBM Verify Identity Governance became that analytical and control plane: it aggregates identity data, supports bidirectional integration through brokerage adapters, applies predictive and prescriptive analytics, and introduces activity-based compliance management and separation-of-duty modeling. The combined architecture lets Exostar onboard external users quickly, provide federated access, and centrally manage certification and remediation with far less manual work. By embedding IBM Verify into a platform already used across highly regulated industries, Exostar turned identity governance into a faster and more operationally scalable service.

solution_components.name: IBM Verify Identity Governance
solution_components.role: Aggregates identity data, applies analytics and automates certification, provisioning and compliance controls for third-party access.

solution_components.name: Access: One
solution_components.role: Provides the collaboration and external identity platform that IBM Verify governs and extends.

data_flow: Identity and entitlement data from Access: One flows into IBM Verify Identity Governance, which correlates permissions into business roles, applies risk and compliance analytics, automates provisioning decisions and returns governed access workflows to Exostar's customer ecosystem.
business_outcome: Exostar reduced certification effort, accelerated onboarding for partners and suppliers, and improved identity-risk visibility so customers in regulated industries can collaborate more securely and with less manual access governance work.
